title: From study to university student
label: ch:zh-school-six
canDo: I can understand, say, read and write six HSK Level 1 size-and-school words, gaining 大, 学 and 生 one gently staged character at a time before recombining them as 大家, 学生, 大学 and 大学生.

payoff.summary: Three newly secured characters produce six useful words, each checked separately in listening, speaking, unassisted reading and no-model writing.
